title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Mix up the teams
hook: Do the same kids always end up on the same team?
intro: The scrimmages are lopsided every time.
statement: New teammates teach kids new ways to play.
q1: Do you mix teams every practice —
q2: or keep groups steady so kids build chemistry?
q3: Which players have never played together?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But teams bond
cta: Coaches — how do you split teams?
ctaLines: Count off. Jersey colors. Captains pick.
Mix it up or keep groups?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do the same kids always end up on the same team?
Friends always pick each other. The scrimmages are lopsided every time.
New teammates teach kids new ways to play.
Mix teams every time or keep steady groups. There is no single right way.
How do you split teams? Share your habit in the comments.
